decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham is a core category that fits growing German organic demand, and a large firm has the slack to keep it despite no evidence since 2019.
Organic Kasseler extends the organic line cheaply on existing slicing capacity, so with no clear shortfall signal there is little trigger for problemistic search.
Pepper salami is a mainstream variant in the organic range, likely meets aspirations, and costs little to carry.
An exotic teriyaki aspic for the serving counter is a niche seasonal creation, and declining service-counter sales likely leave it below aspiration.
Fennel salami (Fenchelsalami) is an established regional specialty with its own page, suggesting enough importance to retain it despite niche appeal.
Classic liver pâté with veal is a conventional product with steady demand that fits the firm's established business.
